description: One unsigned transaction ending a hold: release (its payee or operator, any time) or, after the expiry and the payee's 4-day grace, reclaim (anyone). Either way every share left goes back to the payer. Until then the payer cannot end it. Warns when releasing would give up accepted vouchers nobody has collected.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
